name: Brick Mania
author: PodBox
help: Break every brick to clear the level. Turn the wheel to move the paddle, or hold Prev and Next. Select serves the ball, lets go of a caught one, and fires the laser. Catch the capsules that fall for power-ups. Breaking bricks without touching the paddle builds a combo that multiplies the score.

options.name: lives
options.title: Lives
options.help: How many balls each game starts with.

options.name: control
options.title: Steering
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel pushes the paddle, faster the faster you turn. Dial: the paddle goes where your finger is on the top half of the wheel.
